scope: 仅使用科威特官方域名（pai.gov.kw / ksm.pai.gov.kw / citra.gov.kw）的英文文本：PAI 能效技术法规适用范围与 KUCAS/TABEK 办理口径 + CITRA 型号核准 + CITRA 持牌人的营销/隐私规则
language_policy: 只收官方英文原文或官方英文译本，且来源必须是科威特官方域名。KWS 标准正文与 WTO 通报英文文本不作为引文来源（非科威特官方托管）；议会立法仅有阿拉伯语官方文本，未收录。
review_policy: decision_level=rule_level 表示官方英文原文与页面原文同时成立时可给规则级判断；substantiation 表示只能判“需要证明”；human_review 表示需人工/律师复核。review_required=true 的条目必须人工复核后才能进入报告结论。ocr_source=true 表示引文来自扫描件 OCR，已逐页与图像核对。

rules.law_name: KWS 1893:2018 — Energy Efficiency Labelling and MEPS for DX Air-Conditioners up to 70,000 Btu/h（PAI 标准详情页）
rules.requirement: 制冷量不超过 70,000 Btu/h、使用 240V 单相或 415V 三相 / 50Hz 电源的风冷 DX 空调，落入 KWS 1893:2018 的强制技术法规范围，须满足能效标签与 MEPS 要求。
rules.evidence_needed: 产品铭牌/规格书中的制冷量、电压、相数、频率；PAI 能效注册号与标签照片。
rules.penalty_or_note: PAI 可依法对不符合技术法规的产品采取措施；本页未列罚则金额，规则不写金额。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: This standard specifies the requirements of 1) energy efficiency labelling and 2) Minimum Energy Performance Standard (MEPS) for air-cooled DX air conditioners with capacities including and up to 70,000 Btu/h. It is applied to units designed to operate in AC single phase circuits of 240 V, and three phase circuits of 415 V with a frequency of 50 Hz.
rules.notes: PAI 页面标注类型为 Kuwaiti Technical Regulation、状态 Active、部长令 15/2018；生效日取标准前言所载 15/10/2018（阿语原文），PAI 页面日期字段为空。

rules.law_name: KWS 1898:2023 — Electrical Clothes Dryers: Energy Performance Requirements and Labeling（PAI 标准详情页）
rules.requirement: 容量不超过 25 kg 的电动干衣机（含洗衣功能的组合机与脱水机除外）落入 KWS 1898:2023 的强制技术法规范围，须满足能效标签要求。
rules.evidence_needed: 产品类型与容量；铭牌；PAI 能效注册号与标签。
rules.penalty_or_note: 低容量/组合机等排除项须按标准原文判断；本页未列罚则。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: This Standard specifies the performance and energy labeling requirements for clothes dryers with capacity up to 25 kg in order to carry a valid energy efficiency label.
rules.notes: PAI 页面：部长令 16/2023，公报 2023-10-08 第 1656 期；强制实施日 2024-10-08 见 README（二手转述）。

rules.law_name: KWS 1899:2023 — Electrical Clothes Washing Machines: Energy and Water Performance Requirements and Labeling（PAI 标准详情页）
rules.requirement: 容量不超过 25 kg、使用 240V 单相 / 50Hz 电源的电动洗衣机（含带烘干功能机型，但本标准只覆盖洗涤功能）落入 KWS 1899:2023 的强制技术法规范围。
rules.evidence_needed: 容量、电压、频率；铭牌；PAI 能效注册号与标签。
rules.penalty_or_note: 安全要求不在本标准内（由 GSO IEC 60335-2-7 覆盖）；本页未列罚则。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: This Standard specifies the performance and energy labeling requirements for electric clothes washing machines with a capacity up to 25 kg, in order that it may carry a valid energy efficiency label.

rules.law_name: KWS 1900:2023 — Refrigerators, Refrigerator-Freezers and Freezers: Energy Performance, Testing and Labeling Requirements（PAI 标准详情页）
rules.requirement: 使用 240V / 50Hz 电源、总容积不超过 1100 L 的冰箱/冷藏冷冻箱，以及容积不超过 850 L 的冷冻箱，落入 KWS 1900:2023 的强制技术法规范围，须满足 MEPS 与测试要求。
rules.evidence_needed: 容积（L）、电压/频率；铭牌；PAI 能效注册号与标签。
rules.penalty_or_note: 吸收式制冷与商用冷柜不适用；本页未列罚则。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: This standard specifies the Minimum Energy Performance Standard (MEPS) and testing requirements of refrigerators, refrigerator-freezers and freezers.
rules.notes: PAI 页面另列适用条件：(a) 240V/50Hz 含嵌入式；(b) ≤1100 L；(c) 冷冻箱 ≤850 L；部长令 16/2023。

rules.law_name: PAI 公告（Announcements，英文）：强制性技术法规与能效注册要求
rules.requirement: PAI 对新增能效品类的公告口径：进口前须满足法规全部要求、在能效自动注册系统完成注册、取得能效标签并把标签印在产品包装上（公告以热水器为例）。该口径是否逐字适用于空调/冰箱/洗衣机，需按各品类公告核实。
rules.evidence_needed: PAI EER/TABEK 注册记录；标签签发记录；包装标签照片。
rules.penalty_or_note: 公告写明不满足要求不得进口；具体处置由 PAI 决定。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: all manufacturers and importers of the above-mentioned water heater products are requested not to import any of these products unless all requirements of the regulation have been fulfilled and the products have been registered through the automated system for energy efficiency registration, the Energy Efficiency Label has been issued, and the label has been printed on the product packaging.
rules.notes: 这是 PAI 现行的通用办理口径（照明公告措辞相同），但本库未取得空调/冰箱/洗衣机对应的 PAI 英文公告，故不直接断言其适用于这三类产品。

rules.law_name: PAI 公告（Announcements，英文）：强制性技术法规与能效注册要求
rules.requirement: PAI 公告要求受管制产品同时遵守 KUCAS（科威特合格保证计划）的全部适用要求与程序；照明产品公告明确该程序自 2026-08-17 起强制。
rules.evidence_needed: KUCAS 符合性文件（TER/TIR 或平台记录）；进口商信息。
rules.penalty_or_note: 未遵守 KUCAS 程序的货物可能无法清关；本页未列具体罚则。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: All applicable requirements and procedures of the Kuwait Conformity Assurance Scheme (KUCAS) must also be complied with.
rules.notes: 同一页面照明公告另写：Compliance with the procedures of the Kuwaiti Conformity Assurance Program is also mandatory, effective from 17 August 2026.

rules.law_name: PAI — About TABEK（KUCAS 电子平台说明）
rules.requirement: 受管制产品的放行与产品注册通过 PAI 的 TABEK 电子平台办理；平台与海关系统对接，用于放行进口货物（页面未标注发布日期，生效日取抓取日）。
rules.evidence_needed: TABEK 账户与申报记录；放行/注册编号。
rules.penalty_or_note: 未通过 TABEK 办理可能影响放行；具体流程以平台为准。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: TABEK is an electronic platform that aims to facilitate procedures on local importers and manufacturers of regulated products under Kuwait Conformity Assessment Scheme (KUCAS) in releasing their shipments or registering their products
rules.notes: 页面为平台介绍，非法律文本；生效日按抓取日记录。

rules.law_name: PAI — About TABEK（KUCAS 电子平台说明）
rules.requirement: TABEK 的目标之一是降低不合规产品进入市场带来的消费者安全风险；页面把“不符合 PAI 批准的技术法规与标准”的产品列为风险来源。
rules.evidence_needed: 产品适用的技术法规编号；符合性证据；市场监管记录。
rules.penalty_or_note: 页面为风险表述，未规定处罚；不得据此推断某一产品不合格。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: to protect the health and safety of the consumer from the damage that may result from Trading products that do not conform to the specifications and technical regulations approved by the Public Authority for Industry

rules.law_name: PAI 公告（Announcements，英文）：强制性技术法规与能效注册要求
rules.requirement: PAI 公告载明：不遵守强制技术法规/部长令规定的，将采取必要的法律行动（以建材强制质量标志公告为例）。
rules.evidence_needed: 适用的部长令编号；PAI 的违规通知或处罚决定。
rules.penalty_or_note: 公告只写“法律行动”，未列金额；不得推断具体处罚。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: PAI further emphasizes that failure to comply with the provisions of the Decision will result in the necessary legal actions being taken against violators.
rules.notes: 该句出现在建材公告，属 PAI 的执法口径表述，不是针对小家电的专门罚则。

rules.law_name: PAI — Kuwait Quality Mark Rules（科威特质量标志规则）
rules.requirement: 未取得科威特质量标志（Kuwait Quality Mark）许可而宣称已获该标志认证，或许可被取消/停止后继续使用该标志，PAI 可依法采取法律行动并适用相关处罚。
rules.evidence_needed: QM 许可证书编号与有效期；PAI 许可查询；页面宣称原文。
rules.penalty_or_note: 页面提到按科威特法律处罚，未列金额；该标志为自愿性认证，不是所有产品的准入前提。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Any company declared they certified for use Kuwait quality mark, or continue to use the mark after cancelation or stopping the license or violation of any information low or regulations
rules.notes: 原文含拼写错误（cancelation/low），按原文照录；QM 为自愿性认证，不能据此推断产品必须获证。

rules.law_name: CITRA Regulation for Approval of Communication Devices Type（Decision No. 153/2021）
rules.requirement: 在科威特进口、分销、出租、销售、许诺销售或使用有线/无线通信设备的任何人，以及上述设备本身，均受 CITRA 型号核准条例管辖。
rules.evidence_needed: 设备是否含无线/有线通信功能；销售/进口主体。
rules.penalty_or_note: 不适用则无需型号核准；适用而未核准的后果见 KW-TA-02。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Any person who imports, distributes, leases, sells, offers for sale or uses used wired and wireless communications devices in the State of Kuwait
rules.notes: 英文 PDF 为扫描件，引文经 OCR 并与图像 p-05（印刷页 4）核对。

rules.law_name: CITRA Regulation for Approval of Communication Devices Type（Decision No. 153/2021）
rules.requirement: 进口任何有线/无线通信设备前，须先取得 CITRA 的设备型号核准证书（Accreditation Certificate）。
rules.evidence_needed: CITRA 型号核准证书及编号；证书有效期；申请主体（制造商或进口商）。
rules.penalty_or_note: 未获核准的设备可能被海关拒绝入境；证书被撤销后不得进口或继续销售（Art. 13(2)）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Accreditation Certificate of devices shall be obtained prior to importing any type of wired and wireless communication devices.
rules.notes: 引文经 OCR 并与图像 p-15（印刷页 14）核对。

rules.law_name: CITRA Regulation for Approval of Communication Devices Type（Decision No. 153/2021）
rules.requirement: CITRA 型号核准以欧盟规则与 CE 标志为基础：申请人须提交证明设备带 CE 标志、并符合 CITRA 通信设备技术标准的法律文件（含符合性声明）。
rules.evidence_needed: CE 符合性声明（DoC）；EMC/RF/安全（手机另需 SAR）测试报告；ISO/IEC 17025 实验室报告；技术规格文件（阿语或英语）。
rules.penalty_or_note: 文件不足可能导致型号核准申请被拒或延迟。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: An Approval of Device Types Certificate may be issued when the applicant submits the required legal documents that prove that the equipment bears the CE marking and conforms to the technical Standards approved for Communication Devices issued by the Authority.
rules.notes: 引文经 OCR 并与图像 p-07（印刷页 6）核对。

rules.law_name: CITRA Regulation for Approval of Communication Devices Type（Decision No. 153/2021）
rules.requirement: 型号核准证书有效期为 3 年，续期由 CITRA 裁量，续期后沿用原证书号。
rules.evidence_needed: 证书签发日与到期日；证书号是否沿用。
rules.penalty_or_note: 证书到期即失去效力，需按 Art. 12 续期或重新申请。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: The Device Type Approval Certificate is granted for a period of three years and is subject to renewal at the discretion of the Authority
rules.notes: 引文经 OCR 并与图像 p-11（印刷页 10）核对。

rules.law_name: CITRA Regulation for Approval of Communication Devices Type（Decision No. 153/2021）
rules.requirement: 续期申请须在证书到期前最多 3 个月内、到期后 20 个工作日内提交；逾期证书终止且不再续期。
rules.evidence_needed: 续期申请记录与提交日期；证书到期日。
rules.penalty_or_note: 逾期未续期须重新申请（新证书号）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: The applications for renewal of the certificate shall be submitted within a maximum of 3 months before its expiry, within 20 working days after the expiry date of the Type Approval Certificate.
rules.notes: 引文经 OCR 并与图像 p-11（印刷页 10）核对。

rules.law_name: CITRA Regulation for Approval of Communication Devices Type（Decision No. 153/2021）
rules.requirement: 已获核准的设备在型号、设计、功能等方面发生变更时，须重新申请核准，以确认仍符合技术法规与标准。
rules.evidence_needed: 变更说明（硬件/软件/型号）；原证书；重新核准记录。
rules.penalty_or_note: 未重新核准的变更可能使证书失效。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: In the event that the used wired and wireless communications devices, which have previously been granted the Approval Certificate from the Authority with regard to the model type, design, tasks and functions, are subject to modification, in that case, it shall be approved again to ensure its conformity to the technical requirements stipulated in these regulations
rules.notes: 引文经 OCR 并与图像 p-14（印刷页 13）核对。

rules.law_name: CITRA Regulation for Approval of Communication Devices Type（Decision No. 153/2021）
rules.requirement: 型号核准证书被撤销后，相关设备不得再进口；已进口的设备不得继续在科威特市场销售。
rules.evidence_needed: CITRA 撤销决定/公告；证书状态；在售型号是否属于被撤销范围。
rules.penalty_or_note: 撤销后继续销售可能面临召回、下架等处置（具体措施由 CITRA 决定）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: However, such devices and equipment may not be imported, and the existing equipment may not be offered for sale in the State of Kuwait.
rules.notes: 引文经 OCR 并与图像 p-13（印刷页 12）核对。

rules.law_name: CITRA User Protection and Privacy Rules Regulation（Decision No. 69/2022）
rules.requirement: 营销宣传不得因不准确、夸大或疏忽而误导或欺骗用户；条例明确举例：同一广告既写“最高可达”又标注最低速度，即属此类。
rules.evidence_needed: 广告原文与上下文；支撑测试数据；限定条件是否同页展示；比较基准。
rules.penalty_or_note: CITRA 可依《通信法》采取措施；罚则见阿拉伯语原文（本库未取得官方英文版）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Marketing practices must not result in misleading or deceiving the beneficiary/user via inaccuracy, overstatement or inadvertence
rules.notes: 适用范围仅限 CITRA 持牌人/服务提供者（含内容提供者），不自动适用于普通零售商或品牌独立站。引文经 OCR 并与图像 p-17 核对。

rules.law_name: CITRA User Protection and Privacy Rules Regulation（Decision No. 69/2022）
rules.requirement: 广告中的注释或免责声明须清晰、可理解，且不得与宣传主旨矛盾或削弱主旨（例如大字宣称、小字否定）。
rules.evidence_needed: 广告全图/落地页截图；免责声明的字号、位置、对比度与可读性；与主宣称的逻辑关系。
rules.penalty_or_note: CITRA 可依《通信法》采取措施；罚则见阿拉伯语原文（本库未取得官方英文版）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Any comments or disclaimers must be so clearly and understandably included in the marketing practices, that they would not be inconsistent with the core of marketing practices, impair or change that essence.
rules.notes: 适用范围同上（CITRA 持牌人）。引文经 OCR 并与图像 p-17 核对。

rules.law_name: CITRA User Protection and Privacy Rules Regulation（Decision No. 69/2022）
rules.requirement: 持牌人须要求使用其网络发送商业信息者：仅在科威特时间 07:00–22:00 发送，并提供发送者身份信息与可用的退订方式。
rules.evidence_needed: 商业短信/推送的发送时间；发送者标识；退订入口与记录。
rules.penalty_or_note: CITRA 可依《通信法》采取措施；罚则见阿拉伯语原文。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: the time allowed for sending commercial messages shall be that between seven AM and ten PM, as per the State of Kuwait time.
rules.notes: 适用范围为 CITRA 持牌人/服务提供者；引文经 OCR 并与图像 p-16 核对。

rules.law_name: CITRA User Protection and Privacy Rules Regulation（Decision No. 69/2022）
rules.requirement: 持牌人须在官网条款中公布投诉处理程序，或在自有服务点及授权分销点提供纸质版本。
rules.evidence_needed: 官网条款中的投诉程序页面截图；服务点纸质材料照片。
rules.penalty_or_note: CITRA 可依《通信法》采取措施；罚则见阿拉伯语原文。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Licensee or Service Provider must provide beneficiaries/users with the details of procedures for complaint through publishing those procedures in the terms and conditions available on his electronic website, or make available the hard copy at his own service divisions and at the authorized distributors' divisions.
rules.notes: 引文经 OCR 并与图像 p-14 核对；适用范围为 CITRA 持牌人。

rules.law_name: CITRA User Protection and Privacy Rules Regulation（Decision No. 69/2022）
rules.requirement: 未取得用户（或其正式授权代表）的明确同意，不得收集、使用或披露用户的个人信息。
rules.evidence_needed: 隐私政策与同意弹窗截图；Cookie/表单的同意机制；收集字段清单与用途。
rules.penalty_or_note: CITRA 可依《通信法》采取措施；罚则见阿拉伯语原文（本库未取得官方英文版）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Not to gather, use or disclose any personal information pertinent to beneficiary/user without obtainment of his own or his duly delegated deputy's official consent.
rules.notes: 适用范围仅限 CITRA 持牌人；科威特无通用个人信息保护法，非持牌主体的隐私义务不在本库覆盖范围内。引文经 OCR 并与图像 p-14 核对。

rules.law_name: CITRA User Protection and Privacy Rules Regulation（Decision No. 69/2022）
rules.requirement: 须说明收集个人信息的目的、为提供服务所必需的范围，以及信息的使用方式。
rules.evidence_needed: 隐私政策中的目的说明；字段与目的的对应关系；是否为提供服务所必需。
rules.penalty_or_note: CITRA 可依《通信法》采取措施；罚则见阿拉伯语原文（本库未取得官方英文版）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: State the purpose of collecting personal information pertinent to beneficiary/user, and necessary for provision of service as well as how this information is used.
rules.notes: 适用范围仅限 CITRA 持牌人。引文经 OCR 并与图像 p-14 核对。

rules.law_name: CITRA User Protection and Privacy Rules Regulation（Decision No. 69/2022）
rules.requirement: 向关联公司或第三方披露用户个人信息用于营销前，须取得用户同意。
rules.evidence_needed: 第三方共享清单；营销共享的同意记录；隐私政策对应条款。
rules.penalty_or_note: CITRA 可依《通信法》采取措施；罚则见阿拉伯语原文。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Obtain beneficiary's/user's consent before disclosing any piece of his own personal information to an affiliated company or a third party for marketing purposes.
rules.notes: 适用范围仅限 CITRA 持牌人。引文经 OCR 并与图像 p-14 核对。
